name: Squarespace
description_en:
Squarespace is a product in the Website builders category. Its directory profile covers Templates, WYSIWYG Editor, Online Store Builder, Online Booking, Content Import-Export, Drag and Drop, Newsletter Management, Surveys.

Additional listed capabilities include Landing Pages (Web Forms), SEO Management. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS). The listed organization sizes are Medium Business Small Business. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $16.0. Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: reuse predefined layouts or workflow structures; edit content while previewing its visual presentation; move items directly through a visual interface; coordinate tasks intended to improve search discoverability. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Squarespace 属于网站构建软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括模板、所见即所得编辑器、网店构建器、在线预订、内容导入与导出、拖放操作、订阅邮件管理、问卷。

资料还列出落地页与网页表单、搜索优化管理。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS)。资料所列适用组织规模为中型企业 小型企业。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $16.0. 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：复用预设版式或工作流结构；编辑内容时同步查看其视觉呈现；通过可视化界面直接拖放内容项；协调改善搜索发现的相关工作。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
